convert_string_to_keys: convert a string to a list of pynput key representations using CharacterSet str_to_keys
convert_keys_to_string: convert a list of pynput key representations back to a normalized string using keys_to_str
convert_string_to_labels: convert a string to a list of categorical class labels for model training using str_to_labels
convert_labels_to_string: convert a list of categorical class labels back to a human-readable string using labels_to_str
clean_and_normalize_string: normalize and filter a string to only include supported characters using clean_str
